evals.prompt: I need to create a fungible token called MyToken with symbol MTK, 2 decimals, and initial supply 1,000,000 on testnet. Give me the exact hcli commands using JSON output.
evals.expected_output: hcli token create-ft command with correct flags and --format json.

checks.name: uses-json-format
checks.description: Uses JSON output format as requested
checks.rubric: The output specifies JSON output format (for example --format json or --format=json)

evals.prompt: Before I run any write commands on testnet, what hcli commands should I run to configure the network and operator?
evals.expected_output: Prerequisite commands: hcli network use testnet and hcli network set-operator with account and key.

checks.name: sets-operator
checks.description: Configures the operator account and key

evals.prompt: Create an HCS topic named audit-log and submit the message 'deployment complete' using hcli. Show the commands.
evals.expected_output: hcli topic create followed by hcli topic submit-message with topic reference and message flag.

checks.name: names-topic
checks.description: Assigns a local topic name with --name
